items.title: Tom Albert and Milton "Mooney" Martin Interview, 1964-12-21
items.q: That's the first time I Lowe I see them.

ctx.x: That's all? Yeah. Of course, I used to play for the soldiers. When they first built a building there, at the Naval Station, when the... The dock, the dock come in about six o'clock that morning, they had built a kind of thing on the levee, you know, but they had built that big building over there. I believe that was what, number 11? Number 11. So they had soldiers there then. And so Lowe, they just had come here. That's the first time I Lowe I see them.
Yeah, I think I was playing violin, and I'd take them to play a cornet with me that time.
